gemini.rationale: The customer-facing brand and product supply (T4) crossed the boundary via license and sourcing agreements, while the operational processes (T5) to run the stores did not transfer from RadioShack, creating a structural gap. This gap was mitigated at closing by the Master Sourcing Agreement and License Agreements. The operating processes and management (T6) for the new stores were aligned under the majority-controlled entity, so no T5/T6 gap existed.
